in_sanskrit.name: देवन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning:
देव (Deva) + न (na) = देवन (Devan)

Deva is a Sanskrit term for a god or deity. Na is a suffix which denotes 'belonging to'. Thus, Devan means 'belonging to a god' or 'godly'.
